description.ja: ①クリアグリーンのウンチ型が同梱
description.en: ① Clear green poop mold included

description.ja: ねこ＆くまに付属したウンチ型のクリアグリーンVer.になります。
description.en: This is the poop-shaped clear green version that comes with the cat and bear.

description.ja: うんこ型に比べても扱いやすいとご好評いただいております。
description.en: It has been well received for being easier to handle than the poop mold.

description.ja: 色味はサイバー戦士に付属のウンコ型と同じになりますので、ぜひ大小(ウンコ・ウンチ)をそろえていただければと思います！
description.en: The color is the same as the poop mold that comes with the Cyber ​​Warrior, so please make sure to match the size (poop/poop)!

description.ja: ②ティラノの口
description.en: ② Tyranno's mouth

description.ja: 上下2パーツに分かれておりますのでお好みの角度で組み立てていただければと思います！
description.en: It comes in two parts, top and bottom, so you can assemble it at any angle you like!

description.ja: 他のパーツと同じく、優しくぶっさしますと、抜けやすくなります。
description.en: Just like with the other parts, it will come off easily if you gently brush it out.

description.ja: 保持力を重視される場合には、どうか躊躇せず、ぶにゅっと差し込んでいただければと思います。
description.en: If holding power is important to you, please don't hesitate to insert it firmly.

description.ja: 特にアニマルは小さめのパーツが多くなっておりますので、いずれも深めにぶっ挿してください。
description.en: In particular, animals have many small parts, so please insert them deeply.

description.ja: また、ライオンのひげのスタンプも含めまして、ウンチにぶっさす・押し付ける際にはウンチ型の使用をおすすめします。
description.en: We also include a stamp of a lion's beard, and we recommend using a poop-type when applying or pressing it onto poop.

description.ja: こうすることで、形崩れを防ぎきれいなウンチのまま、完成させることが可能です。
description.en: By doing this, you can prevent the poop from losing its shape and keep the poop clean.

description.ja: ③粘土もパーツもミックス！
description.en: ③ Mix clay and parts!

description.ja: ライオンの体の基本構成はねこ・くまと同じですが、ティラノサウルスは全く別の物となります。
description.en: The basic structure of a lion's body is the same as that of a cat or bear, but a Tyrannosaurus rex is completely different.

description.ja: 2色の粘土ということもあり、1パッケージ内での組み合わせの自由度は過去一番かと思います。
description.en: Since there are two colors of clay, I think this is the most flexible combination in one package ever.

description.ja: ぜひオリジナルうんこ/うんち(それ以外)も組み合わせていただければと思います。
description.en: I would love for you to combine the original poop/poop (other than that) as well.

description.ja: せっかくのライオン・ティラノなので・・
description.en: Because it's the lion Tyranno...

description.ja: 男児心とクソエイティブが爆発してしまいました。
description.en: My boyish mind and shiteative exploded.

description.ja: 意図せず入ったひびも良い感じです！
description.en: Even the unintentional cracks look good!

description.ja: こんな遊びができるのもクレイモデルキットの良いところです。是非うんこやキット内のパーツに縛られず、自由に楽しんでくださいませ。
description.en: One of the great things about Clay ModelKit is that you can play like this. Please feel free to enjoy it without being tied to poop or the parts in the kit.

description.ja: ◆11月発売予定アイテムは、何がスーパーDXなのか
description.en: ◆11ReleaseScheduled item, what is super DX?

description.ja: POINT①：粘土の量がDX！
description.en: POINT①: The amount of clay is DX!

description.ja: これまで、アニマル用は15ｇでしたが、本セットではシリーズ初となる赤色・水色・灰色に加えて、使い勝手の良い白、が全て30g入ります。
description.en: Previously, the animal size was 15g, but this set includes red, light blue, gray, and easy-to-use white, all 30g for the first time in the series.

description.ja: 4体作ってもそれなりの量が余りますので、混色や別色作成もお楽しみください。
description.en: Even if you make 4 of them, there will be a certain amount left over, so please enjoy mixing colors and creating different colors.

description.ja: POINT②：成形色がDX
description.en: POINT②: Molding color is DX

description.ja: ウンコ型・ウンチ型も含めて、全ての成形色がこれまでの発売品とは異なります。
description.en: All molding colors, including the poop type and poop type, are different from previous release products.

description.ja: 特にぱっと見同じに見えるアイドルの乳白も、ラメ入りのスペシャル仕様です。
description.en: In particular, the milky white of the idols, which look the same at first glance, is also a special specification with glitter.

description.ja: そして同じ形だからこそ、通常版の同キャラクターのパーツとの組み換えもお楽しみいただけます！
description.en: And because they have the same shape, you can also enjoy combining them with parts of the same character from the regular version!

description.ja: 作例はぜひ次回に・・と思いつつ、サイバー戦士を組み合わせた一例になります。
description.en: I'll be sure to write an example next time, but this is an example of a combination of cyber warriors.

description.ja: 更にシールも色味や一部デザインを更新しておりますのでこちらも併せて
description.en: In addition, Seal has also updated its color and some designs, so please take a look at this as well.

description.ja: 次回ご紹介いたします！
description.en: I'll introduce you next time!

description.ja: POINT③粘土遊び用シートが付属！
description.en: POINT③ Comes with a sheet for playing with clay!

description.ja: ①・②に加えて、こちらのシートが入ります。
description.en: In addition to ① and ②, this sheet is included.

description.ja: 見た目はもちろん、机なども汚さない、といった機能面でも大活躍間違いなしです。
description.en: It is sure to be very useful not only for its appearance but also for its functionality as it does not stain your desk.

description.ja: 是非ご活用ください！
description.en: Please take advantage of it!
